_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored, per-machine) and set inputDeviceName/outputDeviceName + any tuning. The MAC/IP/COM/host below are this rig's real values - adjust if yours differ.
_steamMachineName: OPTIONAL: the gaming PC's Steam client name (its Windows hostname). Only needed if you are ALSO signed into Steam on another PC that could be listed first - it pins install-by-voice/download-status to this box. Empty = use the first signed-in client.

voice._wakeTuning: All five OPTIONAL (audio.py/voice_agent.py read them with defaults) and deliberately not in REQUIRED_VOICE - a per-machine config.json is gitignored, so a key that is mandatory in code is an agent that will not start after a git pull. wakeNearMissFactor (fraction of wakeThreshold): emit wake_near_miss for a run of scores that got this close and never crossed - the ONLY trace recall leaves, since a wake that does not fire logs nothing. Raise it toward 1.0 if a loud room makes it chatty. wakeClipsKeep: how many fired pre-rolls to keep under logs/wake as wavs, the corpus a custom verifier trains its negatives on; 0 disables, 200 is ~13 MB.
voice._wakeGates: wakeVadThreshold (0-1, Silero speech gate) and wakePatience (N consecutive frames above threshold, costing (N-1)*80ms, capped at 30 by openWakeWord's prediction buffer) are RECOMMENDED AT 0, not merely unset. Both suppress detections, and on 2026-08-15 the acute failure was already too FEW detections - adding a second gate before the near-miss data exists would remove the measurement and the symptom at the same time. Turn them on when wake_near_miss shows real margin: VAD first (0.3-0.5), which kills effects and music but never TV dialogue, since dialogue is speech and passes cleanly.
voice._duckSteps: vol_down steps applied for the length of a session, undone on close (Dispatch.duck). 0 = off. Ducking cannot help the wake word - nothing knows to duck until it has already fired - but it hands the STT a quiet room for every command after it, which is the half that measurably fails: a talker on the couch reaches the mic 10-20 dB below TV dialogue. Relative steps because Ex-Link is send-only and the level to restore cannot be read. 10 is a starting point, not a measurement - it is TV volume points, so tune it against how loud you actually watch.
voice._eagerEot: DORMANT on pipecat 1.7: Flux sends EagerEndOfTurn but it arrives as an interim frame that nothing downstream screens, so these two buy no latency today. Left on so a pipecat that implements the cancellable path pays it back for free - see session_runtime's note before changing them.
voice._navTargets: Spoken form -> nav kind. List every determiner you'd say: the {target} slot is an exact list, so a form that is missing here does not fall back, it falls THROUGH to the wildcards below Nav in grammar.yaml - 'show me my downloads' was landing on ShowCollection and dying there because only 'my library' had been listed.
